safety_invalidation_rules_en: Do not misjudge a single or multiple chemotherapy records as completion of all definitive treatment.

completion_criteria_en: Complete post-treatment status assessment, with clear documentation of efficacy, toxicity management, and subsequent plan.
partial_criteria_en: Outcomes of both hospitalizations are documented as improvement, but there is no objective tumor response or complete toxicity assessment.
safety_invalidation_rules_en: If serious treatment-related adverse events or disease progression are subsequently found, this management stage cannot be considered complete.

completion_criteria_en: Complete discharge safety verification, clearly establish the discharge decision, oncology specialist follow-up time, and subsequent treatment/monitoring plan.
partial_criteria_en: The latest hospitalization outcome was improvement, supporting consideration of discharge, but public evidence does not yet show complete discharge-safety verification and follow-up arrangements.
safety_invalidation_rules_en: If an unstable condition, severe chemotherapy toxicity, or another acute indication for hospitalization is identified before discharge, discharge transition to follow-up must not be completed.
